title: Hopformer: Homogeneity-Pursuit Transformer for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2607.22299v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Forecasting multiple time-series with high-dimensional covariates presents a core challenge: unifying common temporal patterns while retaining meaningful series-specific information. We introduce Hopformer (Homogeneity-Pursuit Transformer), a two-stage framework that addresses this challenge. In the first stage, we perform a Sparsity Pattern Aggregation (SPA) scheme extracting a common low-variance trend that incorporates the covariates. This acts as a homogenization layer. In the second stage, a LoRA-fine-tuned Transformer models the remaining complex dependencies in the residual. Our method is theoretically grounded. We prove that SPA achieves a near-optimal bias-variance trade-off via an oracle inequality. We also provide generalization bounds for the second stage under dependent time series data. Hopformer sets a new state of the art, improving MASE by an average of 6.56% across synthetic and real-world forecasting benchmar

translated_title: Hopformer：面向时间序列预测的同质性追求Transformer
translated_abstract: 对包含高维协变量的多条时间序列进行预测面临一个核心挑战：如何在统一共同的时间模式的同时保留有意义的序列特定信息。我们提出了Hopformer（同质性追求Transformer），一个解决该挑战的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，我们执行稀疏模式聚合（SPA）方案，提取一个融合协变量的共同低方差趋势，这充当了一个同质化层。在第二阶段，一个经LoRA微调的Transformer对残差中剩余的复杂依赖关系进行建模。我们的方法具有坚实的理论基础：我们通过oracle不等式证明SPA实现了近乎最优的偏差-方差权衡，并在相依时间序列数据下为第二阶段提供了泛化界。Hopformer创造了新的最先进水平，在合成和真实世界预测基准上平均将MASE提升了6.56%。
tldr: Hopformer提出两阶段时间序列预测框架，先通过稀疏模式聚合（SPA）提取融合协变量的共同低方差趋势作为同质化层，再用LoRA微调的Transformer建模残差中的复杂依赖，在理论上证明了近最优偏差-方差权衡与泛化界，在多个基准上平均提升MASE 6.56%。
en_tdlr: Hopformer is a two-stage forecasting framework that first extracts a common low-variance trend via Sparsity Pattern Aggregation (SPA) as a homogenization layer and then models residual complex dependencies with a LoRA-fine-tuned Transformer, with theoretical guarantees and an average 6.56% MASE improvement across benchmarks.
